events.text: Perform this task: put all objects with blue color into the black basket to the left, and put all other objects into the blask basket to the right. Save all images during the process.

Understood—I’ll defer those measurements and use the existing TCP offset with visual checks. Any object containing blue will go in the far-left basket; the others will go in the near-right basket. I’ll save every camera image I use.

The corn is in the right basket. The red cube lifted but slipped during transfer and displaced a nearby object. I’ve stopped the arm; I’ll recheck the object positions and use a deeper grasp before resuming.
